_doc: Write your name on the world (systems/namedLegacy.js; the panel ui/actionMenu/namedLegacy.js, Dynasty → Your Name on the World). Late spends of Prestige and gold that outlive the ruler. CODE: a ruler sets jurists to compile the realm's laws into a code bearing their name (the Code of Aldric): costs code.prestige Prestige and code.goldBase + code.goldPerTown per town of the realm from the treasury (paid to the capital's jurists, CrownBooks.spendAtCapital), takes code.days days, then fixes each law as it stands: changing a codified law (Laws.canEnact) costs repeal.prestige Prestige, repeal.treasury more gold and repeal.stability more stability, and strikes it from the code. A code in force adds stabilityOnce at its proclamation and stabilityPerMonth every 30 days while the realm's stability is under stabilityCap; cases before the ruler's court come disputeFactor as often and a rival's suit may be shut by the code (settleShare); the other realms' hostility (coalitions) is respect × as high against a crown under a code; the courts name the code in their verdicts. An AI ruler of a steady realm (stability ≥ ai.minStability) may compile one too (ai.yearlyShare a year, a hash roll). NAMES: a town, a region (the land within region.radius of a town) or a sea (the water within sea.radius of the nearest water to a coastal town) named after the House or its ruler: prestige + gold from the purse into the town. A town of the House's own culture is proud (a 'name' mark: mood, a plaque, prestige.prideYearly a year); another culture resents it (a grudge of grudge.mood for grudge.years years, the realm's stability −grudge.stability), and a resentful town takes its old name back once out of the House's hands for revertYears years. MYTH: a founding myth from the House's real deeds, adopted for myth.prestige + myth.gold; each reign may invoke it once: rally (stability, officers' loyalty), legitimacy (only in the first legitimacyDays of a reign: more of both, and a steadier succession), a claim (+claim Heralds' claim on a realm). Townsfolk repeat it (systems/overheard.js). FINAL CHAPTER: a ruler of finalChapter.minAge or more (or within nearDeathYears of their span) chooses what they are remembered for and the House's motto: the epitaph, the Annals' Legacy, the chronicle book's epilogue and the Hall of Houses say it, and the heir takes the choice's trait.

lines.codeSettled: The clerks of {court} opened {code} and shut the matter: {house}'s suit is not heard.
lines.codeBound: {law} is fixed in {code}: to change it is to strike it from your forebear's book.
lines.renamedProud: The folk of {old} take to the new name, {new}, and raise a stone to it in the square.
lines.renamedResent: The folk of {old} mutter at the new name, {new}: it is not their tongue, nor their House.
lines.renamedReverted: {new} is {old} again: with your House's hand gone from it, the folk took back their old name.
